cpr_01_confirm.text: Call 911 now and put it on speaker! Roll the patient flat on their back. Kneel beside their chest.

cpr_02_agonal.text: Do not stop. Gasping is agonal breathing, not normal breathing. Kneel beside their chest immediately.

cpr_03_position.text: Place the heel of one hand on the center of the chest. Interlock your other hand on top. Lock your elbows straight.

cpr_04_start_beat.text: Push hard and fast to this beat. Push down two inches, then let the chest come all the way up. One, two, three, four.

cpr_05_recoil.text: Keep pushing to the beat. Allow full chest recoil. Do not lean on the chest.

cpr_07_aed.text: If anyone is with you, send them to find an AED right now. Do not stop pushing.

cpr_06_paramedics.text: Stop compressions and step back. Let the paramedics take over. The emergency timeline is saved on your screen. Take a slow, deep breath.

qa_rib_pop.text: A rib pop can happen during effective CPR. Do not stop, keep pushing to the beat.

qa_bed_surface.text: Move them to a firm floor if you can do so safely. Then resume pushing.

qa_vomit.text: Roll them onto their side, clear the mouth, roll them back and immediately resume compressions.

qa_fallback.text: Continue chest compressions to the beat. Emergency services will guide further.
